chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 163: Li Huowang’s Hidden Birthday Ritual & the Copper Coin Mask
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang celebrates Yang Na’s birthday alone in the Gobi, carving her face into a boulder. Then he finds a burned copper coin mask that might finally hide his Heart-Element nature.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 163 – He Kissed a Rock for Her Birthday
og_description: A tender, bleak moment in the desert leads to a game-changing artifact: the copper coin mask that could finally let Li Huowang walk unseen.
